item.name: Determine travel time for many resources, across work or activities they have been assigned

request.name: Determine travel time for many resources, across work or activities they have been assigned

description.content: The Travel Time endpoint will approximate how long it takes for a resource to travel between destinations. It will filter down to relevant availability windows (ignoring destinations outside the resource's availability), order the work to be completed, and finally calculate the travel time between each destination. The result will contain only the node identifier and the relevant travel time.
